title: Ocean
blurb: Deep trenches, coral reefs, tides, and giant sea creatures.

hr.title: Ocean
hr.blurb: Duboke brazde, koraljni grebeni, plima i oseka i divovska morska stvorenja.

questions.q: What is the deepest known spot in the ocean called?
questions.fact: Challenger Deep is about 35,876 feet deep, in the Pacific Ocean near Guam.

hr.q: Kako se zove najdublje poznato mjesto u oceanu?
hr.fact: Challengerov ponor dubok je oko 10.935 metara, a nalazi se u Tihom oceanu kod otoka Guama.

questions.q: About how deep is the ocean on average?
questions.fact: NOAA says the average ocean depth is about 12,080 feet, which is more than 2 miles.

hr.q: Otprilike koliko je ocean dubok u prosjeku?
hr.fact: Prema američkoj agenciji NOAA, prosječna dubina oceana je oko 3.680 metara, više od tri i pol kilometra.

questions.fact: The Pacific is home to the Mariana Trench, the deepest trench in the world.

hr.fact: U Tihom oceanu nalazi se Marijanska brazda, najdublja brazda na svijetu.

questions.q: The Great Barrier Reef is off the coast of which country?
questions.fact: Despite its name, the Great Barrier Reef is made of nearly 3,000 separate reefs.

hr.q: Uz obalu koje se zemlje nalazi Veliki koraljni greben?
hr.fact: Unatoč imenu, Veliki koraljni greben sastoji se od gotovo 3.000 zasebnih grebena.

questions.q: Coral reefs are built by tiny animals called what?
questions.fact: Coral polyps are related to jellyfish. They build hard skeletons that pile up into reefs.

hr.q: Koraljne grebene grade sićušne životinje. Kako se zovu?
hr.fact: Koraljni polipi srodnici su meduza. Grade tvrde kosture koji se gomilaju u grebene.

questions.fact: The Sun pulls on the ocean too. Tides are biggest when the Sun and Moon line up.

hr.q: Što uglavnom uzrokuje plimu i oseku?
hr.fact: I Sunce privlači ocean. Plima je najveća kad su Sunce i Mjesec u liniji.

questions.q: True or false: Challenger Deep is deeper than Mount Everest is tall.
questions.fact: NOAA says Challenger Deep is about 7,000 feet deeper than Mount Everest is tall.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: Challengerov ponor dublji je nego što je Mount Everest visok.
hr.fact: Challengerov ponor otprilike je dva kilometra dublji nego što je Everest visok.

questions.q: Challenger Deep is named after what?
questions.fact: The crew of HMS Challenger first measured the trench's depth in 1875.

hr.q: Po čemu je Challengerov ponor dobio ime?
hr.fact: Posada broda HMS Challenger prva je izmjerila dubinu te brazde 1875.

questions.q: What is the largest animal that has ever lived?
questions.fact: Blue whales can grow to about 100 feet long, roughly the length of a basketball court.

hr.q: Koja je najveća životinja koja je ikad živjela?
hr.fact: Plavi kitovi mogu narasti do oko 30 metara, otprilike koliko je dugo košarkaško igralište.

questions.q: About how much of Earth's surface is covered by ocean?
questions.fact: NOAA says the ocean covers 71 percent of Earth's surface and holds 97 percent of Earth's water.

hr.q: Otprilike koliki dio Zemljine površine prekriva ocean?
hr.fact: Prema agenciji NOAA, ocean prekriva 71 posto Zemljine površine i sadrži 97 posto sve vode na Zemlji.
